text: そういえば　となりの　オーキドはかせが　あなたを　よんでたわよ

structure.jp: となりの　オーキドはかせが

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says an action was going on; here い is dropped and it is past. よんでた = 'was calling'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ is a soft ending used mostly by women. よんでたわよ = 'he was calling, you know'.
